issues.description: Constructor parameter list for class Lecture differs between the template and the specification/solution. The template file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares a constructor with three parameters: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). The problem statement (UML and instructions) and the solution implementation require a five-parameter constructor in this exact order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). This mismatch will cause confusion for students and will prevent code or tests that expect the five-argument constructor from compiling or working as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template Lecture class to declare the constructor with the five parameters required by the UML and solution, in this order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Preferably provide the correct-signature constructor stub (with TODO body comments) so students implement the body but the expected signature is present. Alternatively remove the incorrect three-parameter constructor to force students to implement the correct five-parameter constructor as specified.
